title: Re-prove closure-bound activation for published source
goal: After the early T004 activation-mechanism proof and T010 post-merge source seal are terminal and independently reviewed, repeat the managed Nix/NixOS build-and-activation proof inside the exclusively reserved disposable activation sandbox using only artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source. Realize a fresh immutable closure from the exact T009 merge-commit tree sealed by T010, activate only that receipt-bound closure, independently read back the live closure, prove denied paths are effect-free and prove rollback. This T011 closure—not the earlier T004/T006 closure—is the final activation identity that T003 must bind before storage/cutover rehearsal.

approval.note: Runtime mutation is authorized only inside the exclusively reserved disposable activation sandbox and only after T004 and T010 are terminal. Source acquisition is restricted to the leased immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source produced by T010 from the exact terminal T009 merge-commit tree. /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git, mutable worktrees, moving branches/main, mutable locks and unpinned remote sources are outside T011 authority. Productive Heim-PC activation, boot state, storage, EFI, Secure-Boot, firmware and reboot remain forbidden.

acceptance.assertion: T004 is terminal and independently reviewed, proving the receipt-bound managed build/activation, fail-closed denial and rollback mechanism on the earlier T006 source. T011 treats T004 as mechanism evidence only; T004 closure identity is explicitly not accepted as final T003 activation identity.

T010 is terminal and independently reviewed. T011 binds the exact immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source manifest/digest to the exact T009 merge commit/tree, T009 Captain merge receipt, reviewed T008 PR identity, predecessor ancestry, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. Any artifact/tree/receipt drift fails closed before runtime effect.

Before source bytes are read, T011 holds the artifact.heim-pc.nixos-published-source read claim materialized as the exact artifact path lease and independently re-hashes its immutable manifest/content against T010 terminal evidence.

Build and activation source acquisition read only the leased T010 published-source artifact. T011 has no /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git lease and no mutable source-path lease; any Git object-store, checkout, branch/main, mutable-lock or unpinned-remote reevaluation fails closed before runtime effect.

Before any runtime effect, the run holds the exclusive service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox claim and independently proves the target is disposable and isolated from productive Heim-PC runtime, production storage, EFI, firmware and persistent boot state.

Using only the verified T010 published-source artifact and receipt-bound inputs, a fresh managed sandbox build realizes an immutable NixOS system closure and emits a receipt binding exact T009 merge commit/tree, T010 artifact digest, Control Release Set, effect class and closure.

Sandbox activation consumes only the reviewed T011 managed-build receipt bound to the exact T010 artifact digest/source identity, immutable closure, sandbox target and Activation effect class; caller-supplied source or closure strings alone cannot authorize activation.

Missing, stale, mismatched or unauthorized T004/T010/artifact/review/build-receipt/target authority is rejected before runtime mutation, and evidence proves each denied path leaves sandbox activation state unchanged.

Independent live readback after authorized sandbox activation proves the running/booted system closure exactly equals the fresh T011 approved closure built from the exact T010 published-source artifact.

Observed T011 activation performs no Git, branch/main, lock or remote-input reevaluation after its reviewed build receipt is fixed; runtime evidence demonstrates closure selection remains receipt-bound to the T010 artifact.
Inside the same disposable sandbox, rollback consumes the receipt-bound prior closure/recovery path and independent readback proves the expected rollback closure without mutable-source reevaluation.

T011 terminal evidence designates the fresh published-source-built closure and its source/build/activation receipts as T003’s only final activation identity. T003 must reject the earlier T004 closure or any T011 evidence not bound to the exact T010 artifact/T009 merge tree.
T011 terminates without productive nixos-rebuild switch, productive boot activation, production storage/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, Heim-PC reboot or any equivalent production cutover effect.
The exact T004 mechanism evidence, T010 source artifact, T011 sandbox build, activation, live closure readback, denied-path and rollback evidence are independently reviewed before T011 is terminal.
